teams.headline: Jeanty and Hubbard shine in Week 1 despite tough 101.4–109.5 loss to DRockefeller
teams.commentary: Maintains the #1 overall power rank entering Week 2 on the foundation of an exceptional young roster. Ashton Jeanty's 29.7-point explosion and Chuba Hubbard's 22.2 points confirmed a league-best backfield ceiling, but zero points from tight end Colston Loveland and a quiet 2.4-point day from Terry McLaurin resulted in an 8.2-point loss to DRockefeller. With Jayden Daniels steady at QB (17.7 pts), this team remains the premier championship favorite.

teams.headline: Allen & Gibbs powerhouse fuels 133.9-point rout of akwelch3492; claims #2 rank
teams.commentary: Climbed to #2 in the power rankings after rolling to an emphatic 133.9–112.5 win over akwelch3492. Josh Allen (35.7 pts) and Jahmyr Gibbs (31.1 pts) formed an unstoppable one-two punch, while an elite 95.4% lineup efficiency masked a zero from Kyle Pitts. Ranks #2 in optimal weekly projection (125.1 pts/wk) with a balanced, high-floor roster.

teams.headline: Balanced attack delivers 142.0-point blowout win; holds #3 rank
teams.commentary: Cruised to an emphatic 142.0–106.6 victory over kong58, demonstrating rare roster depth. Four different starters topped 21 points (Zay Flowers 23.5, Chris Olave 23.2, Javonte Williams 21.7, Jalen Hurts 24.7), overcoming a rare 2.2-point opening day from Ja'Marr Chase. Sits securely in the top-three tier with weekly scoring power.

teams.headline: Top-4 tier holds steady despite Week 1 buzzsaw loss to arkinsjt
teams.commentary: Retains the #4 power ranking despite a 142.0–106.6 defeat to arkinsjt. Brock Purdy (22.1 pts) and Breece Hall (18.8 pts) provided a dependable scoring floor, but uncharacteristically quiet outings from Davante Adams (4.1 pts) and George Kittle (2.2 pts) stalled any comeback. Roster balance (96.0) keeps them firmly in playoff contention.

teams.headline: Climbs +4 spots into top-5 tier after impressive 121.9-point win
teams.commentary: The biggest riser across the entire league, jumping four spots to #5 following a convincing 121.9–98.4 victory against sduda351. Trevor Lawrence (26.1 pts) was sharp, Jaxon Smith-Njigba commanded targets for 22.2 pts, and Trey McBride paced all tight ends with 20.0 pts. Strong 93.3% lineup efficiency overcame a -1.0 from Houston's defense.

teams.headline: Taylor and Steelers defense secure 109.5-point upset over #1 mannyrsox24
teams.commentary: Climbed to #6 following an upset 109.5–101.4 Week 1 victory over #1 ranked mannyrsox24. Jonathan Taylor (23.6 pts) and a ferocious Steelers defense (20.0 pts) carried the scoring load, overcoming quiet debuts from Drake London (4.5 pts) and Marvin Harrison Jr. (3.8 pts) alongside Drake Maye's 12.8-point starting quarterback nod.

teams.headline: Scoring explosion (157.2 pts) fuels momentum after Week 1 masterclass
teams.commentary: Delivered a sensational 157.2 points—the second-highest total of Week 1—in a 47.2-point blowout of mdwelch11. D'Andre Swift (31.9 pts) and rookie Jaxson Dart (26.6 pts) torched expectations, while Evan McPherson added a rare 20.5 points from kicker. While season-long depth models keep their baseline at #7, this lineup's weekly ceiling is unquestioned.

teams.headline: Henry & Amon-Ra combine for 58.5 pts, but secondary pieces fall flat in loss
